verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's CUDA Toolkit and CUDA-X docs explicitly list this Blackwell workstation GPU class as a supported target, with tile programming (CUDA Tile C++/cuTile Python) and Transformer Engine support cited, and community reports confirm real-world multi-GPU inference workloads (41k tok/s) running on it. However, hands-on community feedback notes the SM120 architecture used here lacks tcgen05/tmem support and that 'main libraries' are focused on datacenter SM100 parts instead, meaning some CUDA library features are not yet fully supported on this SKU. missing for 10: independent benchmark/doc confirming full parity of major CUDA libraries (cuBLAS/cuDNN/etc.) with SM100 datacenter parts, ROCm/HIP is not applicable so no cross-vendor toolchain evidence.
